description: This PHP class defines the JobTitleService within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to manage job titles and their associated attachments. It interacts with a data access object (JobTitleDao) to perform CRUD operations, retrieves normalized data suited for other system components, and manages job title data for employees.

classes.name: JobTitleService
classes.description: A service class that provides business logic for managing job titles and related attachments within OrangeHRM, encapsulating CRUD operations and data normalization.

methods.name: getJobTitleDao
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and returns the JobTitleDao object used for database interactions related to job titles.

methods.name: setJobTitleDao
methods.description: Sets the JobTitleDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: getJobTitleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job titles, optionally filtering only active titles.

methods.name: deleteJobTitle
methods.description: Flags specified job titles as deleted in the database.

methods.name: getJobTitleById
methods.description: Fetches a JobTitle entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a JobSpecificationAttachment entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveJobTitle
methods.description: Persists a JobTitle entity to the database.

methods.name: getJobTitleArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized JobTitleModel data for all job titles.

methods.name: getJobTitleArrayForEmployee
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized JobTitleModel data for job titles associated with a specific employee, identified by employee number.
